units.source_text: 光阴荏苒，桐壶更衣死后，每次举行法事，皇上必派人吊唁，抚慰优厚。

en.t: As time passed, after the Kiritsubo Consort died, whenever memorial rites were held, the emperor always sent people to offer condolences and gave generous comfort.

units.source_text: 虽然事过境迁，但皇上悲情不减，无法排遣。

en.t: Although time had moved on and circumstances had changed, the emperor's grief did not lessen, and he could not cast it off.

units.source_text: 他绝不宣召别的妃子侍寝，只是朝朝暮暮以泪洗面。

en.t: He would not summon any other consort to attend him at night, but spent every morning and evening washing his face with tears.

units.source_text: 皇上身边的人见此情景，也都忧愁叹息，泣对秋光。

en.t: Seeing this, the people around the emperor also grieved and sighed, weeping before the autumn light.

units.source_text: 只有弘徽殿女御等人，至今还不肯容赦桐壶更衣，说道：

en.t: Only the Kokiden Consort and those around her still refused to forgive the Kiritsubo Consort, and said:

units.source_text: “做了鬼还教人不得安宁，这等宠爱真不得了啊！”

en.t: "Even after becoming a ghost, she still keeps people from finding peace. What extraordinary favor she must have had!"

units.source_text: 皇上虽然有大皇子侍侧，可是心中老是记惦着小皇子，

en.t: Although the emperor had the elder prince by his side, his heart was always thinking of the little prince,

units.source_text: 不时派遣亲信的女官及乳母等到外家探问小皇子情况。

en.t: and from time to time he sent trusted court ladies and nurses to the maternal household to ask how the little prince was doing.
